name: Grain

field_reviews.reason: developers.grain.com documents Personal Access Tokens generated at grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api as the primary per-user auth; calls send 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN'.

Docs confirm PATs, a standard OAuth2 authorization-code flow with PKCE, and Bearer-token authentication headers. Note the docs also define Workspace Access Tokens (Business/Enterprise, admin-generated), a fourth token variant the draft mentions in access_notes but folds under the bearer/token categories - acceptable.

Official support article (support.grain.com/en/articles/15507288-grain-api): 'Personal API access is available on Starter, Business, and Enterprise plans... The Free plan does not include API access'; PATs are self-generated in settings, WATs require Business/Enterprise plus admin. Plan gate confirmed: Starter (paid) or above.

v2 API covers recordings (list/get/update/upload/download), transcripts in four formats, tags, user/team sharing, hooks CRUD, users, teams, and meeting types - reads plus meaningful writes in one domain; medium fits.

Grain also operates an official hosted MCP server at https://api.grain.com/_/mcp, documented in the same vendor developer docs the draft cited (developers.grain.com/mcp, 'Official Grain MCP Server: Quick Start Guide') and announced in Grain's June 18, 2025 release note. Protocols should include mcp alongside rest.

An official vendor MCP server exists and is easy to find in vendor docs: developers.grain.com/mcp documents the 'Official Grain MCP Server' at https://api.grain.com/_/mcp (OAuth, tools like list_meetings/fetch_meeting_transcript/fetch_meeting_notes, usable in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor via mcp-remote), with a matching support article (support.grain.com/en/articles/14811968-grain-mcp) and the June 2025 release note calling it 'Grain's official MCP server... available now for all users'. The draft's claim that no MCP appears in developers.grain.com is wrong. The Composio part of the draft's mcp_notes does hold: docs.composio.dev/toolkits/grain.md still returns 404.
Self-generated PATs on Starter+ with fully public v2 docs, webhooks, and no approval process; buildable immediately on a paid plan. The newly-found MCP only strengthens this verdict.

The Free plan explicitly excludes API access; Starter or above is required for PATs, so paid_plan_required is the accurate gate for the REST API. (The MCP server itself is advertised as free for all users, but the API plan gate stands.)

notes: Opened both draft evidence URLs (developers.grain.com and the support.grain.com Grain API article); auth, plan gating (Starter+ for PATs, Business/Enterprise for WATs, Free excluded), endpoints, hooks, and the Public-Api-Version header all check out. However, the draft missed Grain's official MCP server: developers.grain.com/mcp documents it at https://api.grain.com/_/mcp with OAuth, corroborated by a support article and the June 2025 release note. Corrected mcp_status from none_found to official_vendor_mcp and api_protocols from [rest] to [rest, mcp]. No Composio Grain toolkit (404 re-confirmed).
